push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #3)
push.body:
Ten. Point. Zero. PhogsToffees, that's a Perfect Game #3 and I'd like it laminated, please.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 3rd Perfect Game for us. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ Shot conversion 100%, up from your usual 32%. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. You led by example, and the example was excellent.
+ That connection with BellyTb1 is gold. Don't let it rust.

THE BAD
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Next rep: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Brick by brick.
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 2. That's the stone in your boot. Take it out.
- Lowest shots on the team: 2 (best was tuxedo_slide's 5). We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.

Practice this: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

Gold star, big hug, see you next match. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 9.9 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 9.9 from you against WhoDisBic, BellyTb1. Folks are gonna ask where you learned that. Tell 'em practice.

THE GOOD
+ 100% passing on 22 attempts, up from your usual 77%. You took care of the ball like it was a newborn kitten.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic, your 4th straight match scoring. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ 1 key pass. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ You and PhogsToffees speak the same football language.
+ Your 2nd best match performance of the season (9.9). Keep stacking those.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Training homework: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- Lowest on-ball actions on the team: 26 (best was PhogsToffees's 36). One honest look at that and we move forward.

Drill of the day: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

I'm proud as a peacock. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: W 6-2 vs WhoDisBic | You: 9.1 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 9.1 against WhoDisBic. I'd hug you, but I'd probably cry on your jersey.

THE GOOD
+ 9 tackles attempted (up from your usual 2). You covered more ground than a mail carrier.
+ A brace against WhoDisBic, your 4th straight match scoring. Goals change games, and you changed this one.
+ 1 key pass. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ You and PhogsToffees were like salt and pepper tonight. Better together.
+ Most on-ball actions you've had in 11 matches for us (32). Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- 61% passing (11 of 18). Let's sharpen this: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
- Won 2 of 9 tackles. Tell you what: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged. No sweat, just reps.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 9.1 (best was PhogsToffees's 10.0). Let's not make that a pattern.
- Lowest assists on the team: 1 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Lowest shot accuracy on the team: 40% (best was PhogsToffees's 100%). Easy win: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Coach's drill: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Between you and me, tuxedo_slide: The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso
